bundle.shortDescription: Fast, local-first calendar and task planner
bundle.longDescription: Plan is a fast, local-first calendar and task planner. Day, week and month views, drag-to-create events, recurring events, tasks with subtasks that can be time-blocked onto the calendar, a command palette and quick add. No accounts, no cloud.
